description: Read market depth buckets for `ENERGY` or `BANDWIDTH`. Returns price buckets `{ min, max, value }` optionally scoped by viewer address, minimum delegate amount, and duration. No login required; read-only and idempotent. Use this to estimate market ranges before create/update decisions; pair with `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for quote-style buy estimation and `tronsave_get_order` for one concrete order.

durationSec.description: Optional delegation duration filter in seconds.

minDelegateAmount.description: Optional minimum delegate amount floor for bucket filtering.

name: tronsave_list_order_books
title: Order Book
